text:
Type: rattan bistro dining armchair
Use: dining, sitting at a table, relaxing; dining room, kitchen, sunroom
Style: bohemian, classic, traditional
Materials: hand-woven rattan on a rattan frame, black stained finish
Colors: black, dark charcoal
Shape: oval back with an open diamond lattice weave, curved looped arms, round woven seat, slim legs with cross stretchers, Parisian café silhouette, light and open
Feel: elegant, crafted, airy, charming
Goes with: marble or light wood tables, white walls, green plants; French bistro, bohemian or classic dining rooms
